description_expanded: This beautiful 3rd floor condo in The May is a welcome addition to the rental program. Guest will enjoy two bedrooms, each with a king-sized bed and private baths as well as an extra half-bath. The open great room combines a galley-style kitchen with center island, a dining table with seating for six and a comfortable living room with ample seating. The large balcony provides additional outdoor seating and dining and overlooks the emerging Alys Beach Town Center. This desirable condo is a short walk to all Alys Beach amenities. Parking for this condo consists of one designated space in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
